text: In nineteen fifty-two, a London bus driver jumped a double-decker over Tower Bridge. While it was opening.
The watchman should have rung the warning bell and closed the gates. He didn't. As the number seventy-eight drove on, the road ahead started to rise.
Driver Albert Gunter floored it. The bus leapt the gap and dropped onto the other half, which had not risen as far.
A few passengers had minor injuries. Gunter got a ten pound reward.
Dave tried it the next day. On a bicycle.
